entries.title: Create a member profile workflow relationship map
entries.summary: Use the Memberships module, not Users, when the club is adding a normal member/customer membership profile. The observed Members list exposes the Members tab, FLEX MEMBERS, CREATE MEMBER, Search, Filter Active Members, Membership Type, Filter Columns, Download CSV Members, Print Members, and columns for Title, Email, Membership Card Number, Membership Type, Membership Status, and Actions.

routes.name: Create a normal membership profile
routes.actor: BRS admin or club staff with Memberships access
preconditions: The request is about creating a club member or membership profile.
Do not use this route for staff, admin, receptionist, pro shop, password, permission, or login-account questions.
steps: Open Memberships from the main navigation menu.
Open Members in the Memberships navigation.
Click CREATE MEMBER on the Members screen.
Complete the required fields on the create-member screen, then set the membership type/status and any club-specific membership details shown there.
Save/create the member only after checking the details entered for the member.
Return to Memberships > Members and use Search, Filter Active Members, Membership Type, or the Actions column to confirm the new member profile appears.
routes.outcome: A membership profile exists in the Memberships member list.
verification: The member appears on Memberships > Members.
The visible list columns can be checked: Title, Email, Membership Card Number, Membership Type, Membership Status, and Actions.

relatedWorkflows.reason: A member profile may need a Membership Type before it can be created or correctly categorized.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull this in when the question asks about the type/category/status/flex setup needed for the new member.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Default subscriptions and subscription application can affect the member after the profile exists.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull this in when the user asks about subscriptions, subs, charges, fees, default subscriptions, or what the member should be billed for.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Creating a member and billing that member are separate workflows that often happen together.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull this in when the question asks how to bill, invoice, take payment, create bills, check unpaid bills, or review balances for the new member.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Flexible membership profiles depend on flexible membership type setup and flexi wallet/account handling.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull this in when the question mentions flex, flexi, flexible, wallet, points, balance, or account balance.

relatedWorkflows.reason: After creating or selecting members, staff may need to email or text selected members, membership types, or member groups.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull this in when the question asks about notifying, emailing, texting, messaging, or selecting members.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Bulk upload/import is a different route from creating a single member manually.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull this in when the question asks about importing, uploading, CSV, spreadsheet, many members, or bulk member creation.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Users > Add New creates or manages BRS user/login accounts and is not the normal route for adding a membership profile.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Use only when the question explicitly says staff/admin/user/login/password/permissions or asks for a member login account.

entries.title: User account and login workflow relationship map
entries.workflow: Create or manage a BRS user account
entries.summary: Use Users when the request is about staff/admin/member login accounts, user groups, usernames, passwords, enabling/disabling access, or privileges. Do not use Users > Add New as the answer for a normal membership-profile creation question unless the user explicitly asks about a login/user account.

routes.name: Create a BRS user or login account
preconditions: The request mentions staff, admin, receptionist, pro shop, user account, login, password, user group, privileges, or permissions.
If the request only says add/create a member, use Memberships > Members > CREATE MEMBER instead.
steps: Open Users from the main navigation menu.
Use Add New for a new user/login account.
Set the user group and login/account fields required by the Users form.
Save/create the user only after confirming the account should have that access level.
routes.outcome: A BRS user/login account exists or has been updated.

relatedWorkflows.reason: A member profile in Memberships and a login user in Users are separate concepts.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Use Memberships instead when the user asks about adding a member and does not mention login/access.

entries.title: Membership type setup relationship map
entries.workflow: Create or edit a membership type
entries.navigationPath: Memberships > Membership Types > CREATE MEMBERSHIP TYPE
entries.summary: Membership Types define categories such as full, junior, flex, or other club-defined member types. Observed controls include CREATE MEMBERSHIP TYPE, MEMBERSHIP TYPE CHANGES, Name*, Select Membership Type Status*, Flex, Next Chained Membership Type, subscription search, and default subscription columns.

routes.name: Create or edit a membership type
routes.actor: BRS admin or club staff with Memberships setup access
preconditions: The request is about configuring the type/category itself, not assigning an existing type to one member.
steps: Open Memberships from the main navigation menu.
Open Membership Types.
Click CREATE MEMBERSHIP TYPE for a new type, or open an existing type from the Actions column.
Set Name*, Select Membership Type Status*, Flex, Next Chained Membership Type, and default subscriptions as required.
Save the membership type, then return to Memberships > Membership Types to confirm it appears with the correct Flex, Status, chained type, and Default Subscriptions values.
routes.outcome: A membership type is available for member profiles and billing setup.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Member profiles are assigned membership types.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull member-profile evidence when a question asks how to apply the type to a member.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Membership types can carry default subscriptions.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull subscription setup when the question asks about default subscriptions or charges for a membership type.

relatedWorkflows.reason: The Flex checkbox on a membership type changes how flexible members are managed.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull flexi account/balance workflow when a question mentions flex/flexi/flexible account usage.

entries.title: Membership subscription setup relationship map
entries.workflow: Create, apply, or remove membership subscriptions
entries.summary: Subscriptions are configured separately from member creation and billing. Observed controls include APPLY/ REMOVE SUBSCRIPTION, CREATE NEW SUBSCRIPTION, Search, Filter Columns, Download CSV Subscriptions, Print, and subscription columns such as Name, Cost, Tax Rate, Status, Cycle, and Actions.

routes.name: Create or apply membership subscriptions
routes.actor: BRS admin or club staff with Memberships billing/setup access
preconditions: The request is about subscription setup, default subscriptions, or applying/removing subscriptions.
steps: Open Memberships from the main navigation menu.
Open Subscriptions.
Use CREATE NEW SUBSCRIPTION to create a subscription, or APPLY/ REMOVE SUBSCRIPTION to attach or remove subscriptions.
Check Name, Cost, Tax Rate, Status, Cycle, and Actions on the Subscriptions list before using the subscription for member billing.
routes.outcome: The subscription is configured or applied for Memberships billing.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Membership types can include default subscriptions.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull membership type setup when a question asks where defaults are configured.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Subscriptions can be selected or billed through the billing workflow.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull billing evidence when the user asks how to charge, bill, invoice, or collect payment.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Subscriptions can be attached to member records.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull member-profile evidence when the user asks about one member's subscriptions.

entries.title: Membership billing and payments relationship map
entries.summary: Billing/Payments is for bills, payments, unpaid/overdue items, bill history, and exports. Observed controls include VIEW PAYMENTS, CREATE BILLS, View All Bills, Download CSV Bills, Print, From/To date filters, bill columns, Billing Reference, Due Date, SET BILL FILTERS, Who To Bill, Custom Bill Items, ADD ITEM, Payment Schemes, and PREVIEW.

routes.name: Create or review membership bills
routes.actor: BRS admin or club staff with Memberships billing access
preconditions: The request is about membership bills, payments, invoices, unpaid/overdue balances, or billing exports.
steps: Open Memberships from the main navigation menu.
Open Billing/Payments.
Use CREATE BILLS for new bills, VIEW PAYMENTS for payments, or View All Bills/Search/From/To filters to review existing bills.
When creating bills, set Billing Reference and Due Date, use SET BILL FILTERS and Who To Bill, select subscriptions/custom bill items/payment schemes, then use PREVIEW before finalising.
routes.outcome: Membership bills or payments are created, reviewed, filtered, or exported from Billing/Payments.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Bills and payments are often checked for a specific member profile.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull member-profile evidence when the question asks about billing one named/member record.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Subscriptions are often the billable items in membership bills.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull subscription evidence when the question asks what charges/subscriptions go on the bill.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Bills may target members by cycle, period, or membership type/status.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull membership type evidence when the billing question involves who to bill or membership categories.

entries.title: Flexible membership account relationship map
entries.workflow: Manage a flexible member or flexi balance
entries.summary: Flexible membership questions may require both Membership Type setup and an individual member profile/balance workflow. Do not answer flexi questions only with a generic member-profile route when the question asks to enable Flex on a type, and do not answer setup questions as if they are balance checks.

routes.name: Set up or manage flexible membership
routes.actor: BRS admin or club staff with Memberships access
preconditions: Use Membership Types when configuring the flexi type; use Members/member profile when managing an existing flexi member.
steps: For flexible membership type setup, open Memberships > Membership Types and use CREATE MEMBERSHIP TYPE or edit the relevant type, then use the Flex checkbox.
For an existing flexi member, open Memberships > Members, find the member, and open the member profile.
For flexi money, wallet, points, or balance questions, check the member profile/billing/account area rather than only the membership type setup screen.
routes.outcome: The answer chooses between flexi type setup and existing flexi member/account management.

relatedWorkflows.reason: The Flex checkbox is on Membership Types setup.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull membership type setup when the user asks how to create/enable a flexible membership type.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Existing flexi member balances are managed from the member profile/list area.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull member-profile evidence when the user asks about an existing flexi member or profile.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Flexi wallets/balances may overlap with billing and payment history questions.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull billing evidence when the user asks about money, bill, payment, balance history, or transactions.

entries.title: Member messaging relationship map
entries.summary: Messaging workflows overlap with member profile, membership type, member group, selected member, and timesheet audiences. The answer should choose the route based on the audience named in the question: membership type, membership group, selected members, timesheet contacts, all members, contacts, or SMS/text.

routes.name: Email or text member audiences
routes.actor: BRS admin or club staff with Messages access
preconditions: The request is about notifying members by email/text/SMS or choosing a member audience for a message.
steps: Open Messages from the main navigation menu.
Choose the email or text/SMS area.
Choose the audience route that matches the question: membership types, membership groups, selected members, timesheet audience, contacts, or all members.
Check the selected audience and message content before sending.
routes.outcome: The message is prepared for the correct member audience.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Selected member messaging depends on selecting members from the member list.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull member-profile evidence when the user asks to message selected members or a specific member.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Email/Text Membership Types uses membership types as the audience.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Pull membership type evidence when the question asks to message a membership category/type.

entries.title: Bulk member and contact upload relationship map
entries.summary: Bulk upload/import is the related but separate route for adding many member or contact records at once. It should not be used for a single member unless the user asks about importing, uploading, CSV, spreadsheet, or bulk creation.

routes.name: Upload members or contacts in bulk
routes.actor: BRS admin or club staff with Tools access
preconditions: The request mentions upload, import, CSV, spreadsheet, bulk, or many records.
steps: Open Tools from the main navigation menu.
Open Upload Members and Contacts.
On Import/Update Members or Contacts, choose whether the upload is for Members or Contacts.
Use Update Existing Members only when updating existing member records, then check the upload result before relying on imported data.
routes.outcome: Members or contacts are imported or updated in bulk.

relatedWorkflows.reason: Manual CREATE MEMBER is the single-record route.
relatedWorkflows.answerUse: Use Memberships > Members > CREATE MEMBER when the user asks for one member and does not mention import/upload.
